title: Alfred Partner Manifest v1
description: The manifest a partner registers with Alfred. Stored as OrganizationRegistry.partner.manifest. Frozen with Partner Contract v1: inside version 1 only new optional properties may be added, never removed, renamed or retyped. Registry-owned fields (name, slug, branding) are NOT manifest fields.

$comment.description: Free-text note carried by example and placeholder manifests. Ignored by Alfred.

contractVersion.description: The contract version this manifest is written against. Sent as x-contract-version: 1 on every cross-boundary call.

baseUrl.description: Origin Alfred calls. Every partner endpoint is <baseUrl>/api/v1/alfred/*. HTTPS only, on dev too. No trailing slash.

audience.description: The aud claim of every Alfred-to-partner token. Format partner-<slug>; the partner resolves its own org from aud. Unique across partners.

displayName.description: Name shown to members. Falls back to OrganizationRegistry.name when absent.

capabilities.description: Standard capabilities this partner implements. Declaring one obliges the partner to the endpoints listed in Partner Contract v1 section 9.

locations.description: Physical or virtual locations. At least one is required by Alfred when services, classes or clinical is declared (capability-dependent, so enforced by Alfred, not by this schema).

url.description: Where the full terms are published.

version.description: Opaque version string. Alfred records the value the member accepted and echoes it to the partner as acceptedTermsVersion.

summary.description: One paragraph Alfred shows in the app before acceptance.

terms.description: Partner terms the member accepts before a first order at this partner.

summary.description: Human-readable policy shown in the app. Display only: Alfred performs no window arithmetic and always asks GET /bookings/{bookingRef}/cancellation-quote.

windowHours.description: Display value for the free-cancellation window. Not authoritative: the authoritative answer is the live cancellation quote.

lateFeeCents.description: Display value for the late-cancellation fee, in minor units of the partner's currency.

email.description: Partner support address shown to members and used by Alfred operators. Never a member address.

customTools.description: Partner-specific tools Alfred AI may call at POST <baseUrl>/api/v1/alfred/tools/execute. Names must be unique within the manifest (enforced by Alfred). Every tool requires platform-admin approval before Alfred AI may use it; approval state lives on Alfred and never in the manifest.

membershipRequiredByDefault.description: When true, catalogue items of this partner default to visibility "members" unless the item says otherwise.

exerciseLibrary.description: When true the partner serves GET /exercise-library and Alfred builds this partner's members' workouts from it. Requires the trainings capability.

trainings.description: Optional configuration for the trainings capability.

sensitivity.description: How this partner's message threads are handled. "clinical" threads need a plan with clinician chat to open and to send, carry no message text in notifications or push, never reach the AI assistant, and every staff read is audited. Stamped on a thread when it is created. Requires the messaging capability.

messaging.description: Optional configuration for the messaging capability.

staffDirectoryUrl.description: Optional human-facing page listing the partner's staff. Alfred never fetches it; it is shown to platform admins.

ref.description: Partner-owned opaque location reference. Alfred echoes it back as locationRef and stores it on Listing.locations[].partnerLocationRef.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Every local time the partner returns is resolved against this zone.

openingHours.description: Local opening hours per weekday, in the location's timezone. A missing or empty day means closed. Display only: bookable time comes from GET /availability.

name.description: Tool name sent as toolName in POST /api/v1/alfred/tools/execute. There is no endpoint field: every custom tool of every partner is executed at that one path.

description.description: What the tool does, written for Alfred AI to choose it.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the tool input. This is the one object in the manifest that does not set additionalProperties: false, because its own contents are an arbitrary JSON Schema.

writes.description: True when the tool changes partner state. A write tool always requires the member's confirmation before Alfred calls it with confirmed: true.

confirmationText.description: Sentence shown to the member before a write tool runs. Required when writes is true.
